verdict.rationale: Docusign documents its own configurable workflows (docusign-docs-4), a CLM drag-and-drop editor for designing contract processes (docusign-docs-17), and workflow automation in its IAM platform (docusign-docs-45). Its official SDK also states it can be used to "send, sign, and approve documents" (docusign-docs-40). None of this explicitly describes routing contracts to internal approvers as a configurable step before signature, so that depth is only implied. missing for 10: explicit documentation of pre-signature approval routing (approver steps, conditional or sequential approvals), independent or hands-on corroboration of approval workflows.
